title: Geizhals Price Comparison Search Scraper
description: Search Geizhals for products with manufacturer, GTIN, rating summaries, best-price ranges, and product links. Batch keywords across German and European markets.

queries.title: Product searches
queries.description: Product keywords to search across Geizhals markets.

loc.title: Market
loc.description: Market code: de, at, eu, pl, or uk. Defaults to de.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Response language: de or en. Defaults to de.

pagesize.title: Pagesize
pagesize.description: Results per page, between 1 and 1000. Defaults to 10.

sort.title: Sort order
sort.description: Optional sort key as used by Geizhals (e.g. price). Defaults to relevance.

category.title: Category
category.description: Optional Geizhals category id to constrain results.

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer
manufacturer.description: Optional manufacturer id to constrain results.
